algorithms.content_digest: SHA-256 over exact returned UTF-8 content after CRLF and bare CR normalization to LF. It is distinct from snapshot file-byte digests.
algorithms.authority: known canon maps to canon; known revealed maps to revealed; every other known, missing, or unknown raw status maps to preparation. accepted remains preparation.
algorithms.edge_occurrence: occurrence_order is one-based successful parse order within the source record. edge_id is 'edge_' plus lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON {occurrence_order,revision_id,source_record_id}. Canonical JSON uses UTF-8, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace. Backlinks return the identical complete edge object.
algorithms.cursor: Encode {binding,digest,version} as unpadded base64url UTF-8 canonical JSON. version is 1. digest is lowercase SHA-256 over canonical JSON of binding. Binding includes campaign_id, revision_id, tree_digest, normalized query, sorted filters, limit, sort, direction, and boundary. Validate encoding, closed envelope, version, digest, safe identifiers, complete binding equality, then boundary existence. The digest detects corruption and binding changes; it is not authorization.
algorithms.record_search: Unicode casefold substring across record_id, name, Summary, and normalized full content. Query, type, authority, and status filters combine with AND. Sort is record_id ascending. Facets count the complete viewed revision and do not change with active query or filters.
algorithms.history: Creation is ordinal 1 against an empty parent. Entries sort by ordinal. Changes sort by record_id then added, removed, content_changed, metadata_changed, authority_transition. Removed records link to the verified parent revision; added and retained records link to the changed revision. Only verified snapshot comparisons enter approved history. Workflow, audit, table-fact, Draft, and proposal-lifecycle events never enter it.
